findings.title: Hospital Bill Total Differs from Claim Form Amount Claimed
findings.detail: The hospital bill total payable plus the pharmacy bill does not match the amount claimed on the claim form.

findings.title: Billed ICU Days Differ from Discharge Summary Narrative
findings.detail: The hospital bill charges for 2 ICU days, whereas the discharge summary states the patient was managed in the ICU and shifted to the ward on day 2 of admission.

quotes.quote: Managed in the ICU with IV fluids, an insulin infusion and electrolyte correction. Shifted to the ward on day 2 of admission

findings.title: Pharmacy Invoice Location and Date Context
findings.detail: The pharmacy invoice is from a chemist in Noida, whereas the hospital is in Pune, and the invoice is dated on discharge day.

findings.title: Lab Reports Dated on Discharge Date
findings.detail: All diagnostic lab reports are dated 19 Oct 2024, which is the discharge date.
